snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader: The Infinite Museion - Official Teaser Trailer | IGN Fan Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Watch the Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader: The Infinite Museion teaser trailer for a peek at this upcoming DLC for the story-rich classical RPG from Owlcat Games (developers of Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous). Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader: The Infinite Museion will be available on PC (Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.

#IGN #Gaming #FanFest
